newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina says retaliated against 46 nations in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Argentina says retaliated against 46 nations in Q1.

text.p: Argentina took retaliatory measures against 46 countries for what it saw as unfair trade practices during the first quarter, the Economy Ministry said Monday.
The biggest target was the European Union, against which it took 11 measures covering goods including saws, cardboard, fiber optics and shoes.
Argentina also took 10 measures against Brazil covering goods including gas meters, fiber optic cables, gas cannisters and paper sacks for cement.

Argentina took nine measures against China. The subjects of disputes included shoes, locks, playing cards and smelter accessories. Seven measures were taken against the United States dealing with disputes over fiber optic cable, shoes, vaseline, and smelter accessories.
